title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
Liaise with accounting firms for bookkeeping, document preparation, SPED filings, and tax submissions (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).

Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.

title: Technical ai project manager / qa lead
description:
ABOUT CONTENTJET
Content Jet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals.
Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, Open Claw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery.
THE MISSION: SHIELD OPERATIONS AND PERFECT THE AI DEPLOYMENTS
Content Jet is undergoing a massive transformation to become a fully AI-native agency. While our AI Agent Architect and Automation Engineer build the complex infrastructure, we need a ruthless tester and operational bridge.
Your mission is simple: ensure that no buggy agent, broken n8n workflow, or hallucinating AI ever reaches the CEO, our team, or our clients. You are the ultimate gatekeeper of quality and the translator between our agency operations and our engineering pod.
THE ROLE
You are the operational anchor of our AI transformation. You will not be writing the Python code or building the complex multi-agent architectures, but you must be technical enough to understand how they work, how they connect via APIs, and exactly how they break.
You will audit our existing manual operations, write clear documentation detailing exactly what the AI needs to do, and hand those requirements to the engineering team. Once they build an agent (deployed via Open Claw ) or an automation (via n8n ), your job is to try to break it. You will test every edge case, log every bug, and manage the feedback loop until the system is bulletproof and ready for the agency floor.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Audit and Document: Deep-dive into our current agency operations, mapping out every manual click, copy-paste, and email to create clear requirements for the AI Architect.
Relentless QA & Testing: Act as the \"human-in-the-loop\" during the testing phase. You will vigorously test AI agents across Slack, Monday.com, and web interfaces to find edge cases, hallucinations, and logic failures before deployment.
Bug Reporting & Triage: Manage the development pipeline. When a VAPI voice agent fails a creator screening or an n8n webhook drops data, you write the detailed bug report for the engineering team.
Prompt QA: Review the outputs of AI workflows (such as personalized creator briefs or automated emails) to ensure the tone, accuracy, and brand alignment are perfect.
Protect the CEO: Fully own the testing and troubleshooting phase so the CEO can focus purely on running the agency, completely removed from software QA.
Team Training: Once an AI agent or automation is finalized, you will write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and train the Content Jet staff on how to use the new system. MUST-HAVE SKILLS
Exceptional QA Experience: You have a proven track record of testing complex software, automations, or AI workflows and documenting bugs clearly.
Technical Literacy: While you aren't writing production Python, you understand how APIs work, what webhooks are, and the basics of n8n and LLM prompt logic. You know why systems break.
Hyper-Organization: You are a master of project management tools (Monday.com, Jira, Linear) and can manage multiple concurrent AI deployments without dropping the ball.
UGC / Agency Understanding: You understand how a creative agency functions—what a creator brief is, how outreach works, and the level of quality clients expect.
Flawless English Communication: You will be writing detailed technical tickets, testing client-facing AI outputs, and writing internal training guides. NICE-TO-HAVE
Previous experience working in an AI startup or working directly alongside AI Engineers.
Hands-on experience with Monday.com, n8n, or testing chatbot/agent outputs.
Background in UGC, creator operations, or content production workflows.
Aligned with North American time zones (EST/PST). WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Within 30 days: You have fully audited our top 5 manual workflows, created a clear roadmap for the engineering pod, and established a formalized bug-reporting and testing system.
Within 60 days: You are rigorously testing the first wave of deployed AI agents. You have successfully caught, documented, and helped resolve critical edge cases before they impacted agency staff.
Within 90 days: You completely own the AI product lifecycle. The CEO is entirely removed from all QA and troubleshooting, and manual work across the agency is rapidly decreasing thanks to your smooth deployments.

title: Video editor — direct response & performance creative
description:
At Thera Pet MD, we are dedicated to enhancing pets' well-being by creating stress-free, joyful environments. Serving pet owners across the United States and internationally, we provide scientifically backed calming solutions, meticulously formulated by our team of vets and pet wellness experts. Our mission is to ensure that every pet experiences comfort and happiness in its daily life, supported by our commitment to quality and efficacy.
This role is for editors who understand that great performance creative is not just about making things look polished. It's about footage selection, hook instinct, pacing, and storytelling. We care deeply about your ability to know which visual, frame, and opening moment will make someone stop scrolling and keep watching.
We look for editors who can create ads that feel real, emotionally honest, readable, and performance-driven.
What the role looks like:
Direct-response video editing with a strong emphasis on footage selection
Turning hooks, visuals, and messaging into one clear performance story
Working inside a structured creative system designed to keep editors focused
Collaborating with a Creative Director for concepts and direction
Collaborating with a Project Manager who helps with voiceovers, UGC sourcing, and removing production bottlenecks We already have multiple video editors on the team and are onboarding more, so this is not a chaotic "figure it out alone" environment. We make sure that our editors have clarity, support, and autonomy in execution.
What we offer:
Long-term opportunity with a fast-growing brand
Competitive salary
Organized workflow and clear task ownership
Autonomy in the actual editing work
Quarterly performance bonus based on ad results What we're looking for:
Strong direct-response editing instinct
Excellent footage selection and hook judgment
Ability to edit for performance, not just aesthetics
Someone who understands how to build emotional tension, clarity, and relief in the ad flow
Someone with a growth-oriented mindset Process:
1 assessment task
Final interview with our co-founder If this sounds like a fit, please apply with:
Your portfolio
A few examples of direct-response ads you've edited *Applications without a portfolio or example videos will not be considered.*
We look forward to your application!

title: Coordenador de desenvolvimento de software (remoto)
description:
Sobre a Arauc:
Aqui na Arauc transformamos ideias em software, viabilizando o empreendedorismo com startups e digitalizando operações de empresas estabelecidas. Desenvolvemos desde aplicativos mobile e sistemas web até arquiteturas em nuvem, automações e Inteligência Artificial. Somos uma empresa jovem em crescimento, com projetos em diferentes setores e um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e aprendizado constante.
O Desafio:
Para continuarmos entregando produtos digitais de excelência, buscamos um Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Software (REMOTO) apaixonado por tecnologia, com forte visão de produto e focado em resultados. Você será o líder técnico dos nossos projetos, atuando de ponta a ponta: desde a concepção e arquitetura até o deploy, testes e garantia de qualidade. Se você gosta de colocar a mão na massa, gerenciar o fluxo de desenvolvimento da equipe, criar MVPs inovadores e atuar em projetos robustos para grandes empresas, esse é o lugar!
Responsabilidades
Liderar o ciclo de vida completo do software, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade do início ao fim do projeto.
Desenhar a arquitetura das soluções e elaborar documentações técnicas que sirvam de guia claro para a equipe.
Planejar sprints, gerenciar o fluxo de tarefas e acompanhar a evolução técnica dos desenvolvedores.
Assegurar a qualidade do produto final através de revisão de código, rotinas de testes e validação rigorosa das entregas.
Atuar ativamente no código (Full Stack) para acelerar desenvolvimentos críticos ou resolver gargalos técnicos da equipe. Qualificações
Habilidade em planejamento de desenvolvimento de software, gestão de desenvolvedores e garantia de entregas.
Sólida experiência como Desenvolvedor Full Stack.
Forte conhecimento prático em Arquitetura de Software e Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Firebase).
Visão de testes e qualidade de código.
Capacidade de transitar entre o planejamento e a execução técnica.

title: Ai agent architect / builder
description:
ABOUT CONTENTJET
Content Jet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals. Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, Open Claw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery.
THE MISSION: REPLACE MANUAL WORK WITH AI AGENTS
Content Jet is on a mission to become a fully AI-native agency. That means every workflow that currently requires a human clicking, copying, pasting, searching, emailing, or following up manually should be handled by an AI agent instead. We're not looking for someone to build chatbots — we're looking for someone who can systematically identify manual bottlenecks across our operations and replace them with autonomous agent systems that run 24/7 without human intervention.
This includes: creator discovery and vetting, outreach campaign creation, brief reading and task assignment, content pipeline management, quality control, reporting, team notifications, client communication, and any repetitive operational task that currently eats human hours.
THE ROLE
You are the person who designs and builds complete AI agent systems from concept to production. You will own the architecture of multi-agent pipelines — defining agent roles, communication flows, tool integrations, and orchestration logic.
You will work extensively with Claude Code CLI to build, test, and iterate on agent systems directly from the terminal — writing production-grade code, managing project structures, and leveraging Claude's coding capabilities for rapid development. You will use Claude Cowork with MCP connectors to orchestrate complex workflows that read from Monday.com, discover creators on Tik Tok/Modash, create Instantly campaigns, produce personalized documents, and coordinate across Slack channels — all without manual intervention.
You will deploy agents via Open Claw, our open-source AI agent gateway, to make them accessible across multiple platforms (Slack, Telegram, web) with full DM and group chat support, tool management, and multi-model routing.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Systematically audit Content Jet's operations to identify every manual task that can be replaced by an AI agent or automation
Design and build multi-agent systems that fully replace manual workflows: creator sourcing, outreach, qualification, brief processing, campaign management, reporting, and team coordination
Use Claude Code CLI as your primary development environment to build, debug, and ship agent systems rapidly from the terminal
Build complex automation workflows using Claude Cowork with MCP connectors — orchestrating Monday.com, Tik Tok, Modash, Instantly, Google Drive, Slack, and other platforms into seamless, zero-touch pipelines
Deploy and configure agents via Open Claw for multi-platform delivery (Slack, Telegram, web interfaces) with DM and group chat support
Architect agent communication flows, decision trees, tool-use schemas, and escalation logic within the Open Claw gateway
Integrate agents with external tools via APIs and MCP connectors (Monday.com, Modash, Tik Tok, Instantly, Apollo, Apify, Firecrawl, Eleven Labs, Creatomate, etc.)
Build AI-powered creator sourcing and outreach pipelines — from Monday.com brief reading through creator discovery to Instantly campaign creation, with personalized Word document guides produced automatically for team members
Build AI voice agents using VAPI + Claude + Twilio/Telnyx for creator and lead qualification, replacing manual phone screening
Write production-grade Python agent code with proper error handling, logging, Slack integration (multi-channel), and monitoring
Design prompt systems at the systems level — agent instructions, Open Claw tool configurations, Claude Cowork task definitions, output parsing, and quality control
Create CLAUDE.md project files for agent codebases following enterprise-grade standards (security, design philosophy, code organization)
Continuously look for new manual processes to automate — the goal is zero manual work for repetitive tasks MUST-HAVE SKILLS
Python (production-level, not just scripting) — you write code that runs in production 24/7
Deep prompt engineering — system-level agent instructions, multi-step reasoning chains, tool-use orchestration, not simple chatbot prompts
Claude Code CLI proficiency — comfortable building, testing, and shipping entire projects from the terminal using Claude as a coding partner
Claude Cowork experience — ability to design and execute complex multi-step workflows using MCP connectors to orchestrate across platforms
Experience with Open Claw or similar AI agent gateways/orchestration frameworks for multi-platform agent deployment
API integration experience (REST, webhooks, OAuth, API chaining) — you can wire any two systems together
Experience building multi-agent or multi-step AI systems (Crew AI, Auto Gen, Lang Graph, or custom builds)
Strong understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) — how to connect Claude to external tools, databases, and services
Understanding of agent design patterns: Re Act, tool-use, delegation, human-in-the-loop, autonomous decision-making
Experience deploying agents across multiple platforms (Slack bots, Telegram bots, web chat)
Strong English communication (written) — you'll write agent specs, workflow documentation, and team guides NICE-TO-HAVE
Familiarity with n8n (self-hosted) for workflow automation alongside agent systems
Background in UGC, creator economy, influencer marketing, or content operations
Experience with Monday.com API, Modash, Tik Tok Creator Marketplace, or similar creator tools
Experience configuring Open Claw for multi-platform deployment with tool availability management and config troubleshooting
French or Arabic language skills (for MENA market projects) WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Within 30 days: You've audited our current manual workflows, deployed your first multi-agent system via Open Claw integrated with Slack, and shipped a working creator sourcing automation using Claude Cowork with MCP connectors.
Within 60 days: You've replaced at least 3 major manual workflows with autonomous agent systems. You're independently designing agent architectures using Claude Code CLI and deploying them via Open Claw with minimal direction.
Within 90 days: You're leading AI agent delivery across 3–5 concurrent automation projects, have eliminated the majority of repetitive manual tasks in our operations, and are training team members on agent-powered workflows. Manual work at Content Jet is the exception, not the norm.

title: Technical ai project manager / qa lead
description:
ABOUT CONTENTJET
Content Jet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals.
Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, Open Claw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery.
THE MISSION: SHIELD OPERATIONS AND PERFECT THE AI DEPLOYMENTS
Content Jet is undergoing a massive transformation to become a fully AI-native agency. While our AI Agent Architect and Automation Engineer build the complex infrastructure, we need a ruthless tester and operational bridge.
Your mission is simple: ensure that no buggy agent, broken n8n workflow, or hallucinating AI ever reaches the CEO, our team, or our clients. You are the ultimate gatekeeper of quality and the translator between our agency operations and our engineering pod.
THE ROLE
You are the operational anchor of our AI transformation. You will not be writing the Python code or building the complex multi-agent architectures, but you must be technical enough to understand how they work, how they connect via APIs, and exactly how they break.
You will audit our existing manual operations, write clear documentation detailing exactly what the AI needs to do, and hand those requirements to the engineering team. Once they build an agent (deployed via Open Claw ) or an automation (via n8n ), your job is to try to break it. You will test every edge case, log every bug, and manage the feedback loop until the system is bulletproof and ready for the agency floor.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Audit and Document: Deep-dive into our current agency operations, mapping out every manual click, copy-paste, and email to create clear requirements for the AI Architect.
Relentless QA & Testing: Act as the \"human-in-the-loop\" during the testing phase. You will vigorously test AI agents across Slack, Monday.com, and web interfaces to find edge cases, hallucinations, and logic failures before deployment.
Bug Reporting & Triage: Manage the development pipeline. When a VAPI voice agent fails a creator screening or an n8n webhook drops data, you write the detailed bug report for the engineering team.
Prompt QA: Review the outputs of AI workflows (such as personalized creator briefs or automated emails) to ensure the tone, accuracy, and brand alignment are perfect.
Protect the CEO: Fully own the testing and troubleshooting phase so the CEO can focus purely on running the agency, completely removed from software QA.
Team Training: Once an AI agent or automation is finalized, you will write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and train the Content Jet staff on how to use the new system. MUST-HAVE SKILLS
Exceptional QA Experience: You have a proven track record of testing complex software, automations, or AI workflows and documenting bugs clearly.
Technical Literacy: While you aren't writing production Python, you understand how APIs work, what webhooks are, and the basics of n8n and LLM prompt logic. You know why systems break.
Hyper-Organization: You are a master of project management tools (Monday.com, Jira, Linear) and can manage multiple concurrent AI deployments without dropping the ball.
UGC / Agency Understanding: You understand how a creative agency functions—what a creator brief is, how outreach works, and the level of quality clients expect.
Flawless English Communication: You will be writing detailed technical tickets, testing client-facing AI outputs, and writing internal training guides. NICE-TO-HAVE
Previous experience working in an AI startup or working directly alongside AI Engineers.
Hands-on experience with Monday.com, n8n, or testing chatbot/agent outputs.
Background in UGC, creator operations, or content production workflows.
Aligned with North American time zones (EST/PST). WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Within 30 days: You have fully audited our top 5 manual workflows, created a clear roadmap for the engineering pod, and established a formalized bug-reporting and testing system.
Within 60 days: You are rigorously testing the first wave of deployed AI agents. You have successfully caught, documented, and helped resolve critical edge cases before they impacted agency staff.
Within 90 days: You completely own the AI product lifecycle. The CEO is entirely removed from all QA and troubleshooting, and manual work across the agency is rapidly decreasing thanks to your smooth deployments.

title: Virtual assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote
About the job:
We are looking for someone who will help our team with various tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is attentive to detail and organized.
You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with some marketing activities for our agency and our clients. You will be responsible for crafting and sending personalized outreach messages, reporting, creating Canva designs and working with videos, scheduling posts, scheduling meetings, downloading and cleaning databases, and more. Full training is provided.
This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.

Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.

Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.

Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.

title: Video editor — direct response & performance creative
description:
At Thera Pet MD, we are dedicated to enhancing pets' well-being by creating stress-free, joyful environments. Serving pet owners across the United States and internationally, we provide scientifically backed calming solutions, meticulously formulated by our team of vets and pet wellness experts. Our mission is to ensure that every pet experiences comfort and happiness in its daily life, supported by our commitment to quality and efficacy.
This role is for editors who understand that great performance creative is not just about making things look polished. It's about footage selection, hook instinct, pacing, and storytelling. We care deeply about your ability to know which visual, frame, and opening moment will make someone stop scrolling and keep watching.
We look for editors who can create ads that feel real, emotionally honest, readable, and performance-driven.
What the role looks like:
Direct-response video editing with a strong emphasis on footage selection
Turning hooks, visuals, and messaging into one clear performance story
Working inside a structured creative system designed to keep editors focused
Collaborating with a Creative Director for concepts and direction
Collaborating with a Project Manager who helps with voiceovers, UGC sourcing, and removing production bottlenecks We already have multiple video editors on the team and are onboarding more, so this is not a chaotic "figure it out alone" environment. We make sure that our editors have clarity, support, and autonomy in execution.
What we offer:
Long-term opportunity with a fast-growing brand
Competitive salary
Organized workflow and clear task ownership
Autonomy in the actual editing work
Quarterly performance bonus based on ad results What we're looking for:
Strong direct-response editing instinct
Excellent footage selection and hook judgment
Ability to edit for performance, not just aesthetics
Someone who understands how to build emotional tension, clarity, and relief in the ad flow
Someone with a growth-oriented mindset Process:
1 assessment task
Final interview with our co-founder If this sounds like a fit, please apply with:
Your portfolio
A few examples of direct-response ads you've edited *Applications without a portfolio or example videos will not be considered.*
We look forward to your application!

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: People business partner
description:
This role is part of thePeople Successarea and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.
What You'll Do:
Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.
Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.
Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.
Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.
Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.What we expect from you:Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred
4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposurewithin tech companies.
Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.
Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.
Previous experience with Workday is a plus.Soft Skills
Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
Strategic mindset with strong execution.
Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.
Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.What we offer:
Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

title: Engenheiro de vendas sênior
description:
ENGENHEIRO DE VENDAS TÉCNICAS – ELÉTRICA DE ALTA PERFORMANCESe você é um engenheiro que domina o campo técnico, entende profundamente ensaios elétricos e sabe transformar conhecimento em resultados comerciais expressivos, esta oportunidade foi desenhada para você.
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Vendas Técnicas Sênior, com visão estratégica, forte atuação em campo e histórico comprovado de vendas técnicas de alto valor agregado no setor elétrico.O DESAFIO
Você será responsável por conectar soluções técnicas complexas às reais necessidades dos clientes, atuando diretamente em projetos de grande porte, como usinas hidrelétricas, subestações, linhas de transmissão e indústrias de energia.
Aqui, você não “vende produto”.
Você vende confiança técnica, segurança operacional e performance.REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS (ESSENCIAIS)
✔ Experiência mínima de 6 anos comprovada em ensaios elétricos, incluindo:
Megômetro
Microhmímetro
Medidor TTR
Ensaios Hipot
Termografia
Outros ensaios elétricos de média e alta tensão
✔ Atuação sólida no segmento elétrico, com vivência em:
Usinas hidrelétricas
Linhas de transmissão
Subestações
Grandes ativos elétricos
✔ Carteira ativa de clientes no setor elétrico (diferencial altamente valorizado)
✔ Experiência comprovada em vendas técnicas, com:
Negociação consultiva
Elaboração de propostas técnicas
Markup mensal na faixa de R$ 300.000 a R$ 400.000
✔ Capacidade de dialogar com:
Engenheiros
Gestores de manutenção
Coordenadores de projetos
Diretores técnicosPERFIL COMPORTAMENTAL QUE BUSCAMOS
Alta capacidade analítica e técnica
Comunicação clara, objetiva e persuasiva
Autoridade técnica reconhecida
Foco em resultado, performance e crescimento
Conforto em ambientes de alta exigência técnica e comercial
Se você se sente mais motivado quando o desafio é grande, este ambiente é para você.REMUNERAÇÃO E MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO
Ganhos entre R$ 3.000,00 a R$ 15.000,00, conforme modelo e performance
Modelos de contratação:
PJ – Híbrido ou Remoto
Aqui, resultado gera liberdade e crescimento real.POR QUE ESSA VAGA É DIFERENTE?
✔ Você atuará em vendas consultivas técnicas de alto impacto para setor de energia do Brasil
✔ Terá autonomia para negociar, propor e fechar
✔ Seu conhecimento técnico será valorizado, não subutilizado
✔ O crescimento financeiro acompanha sua performance
✔ Ambiente profissional, técnico e orientado a resultadosSe você já construiu autoridade técnica, se domina ensaios elétricos com profundidade, e sente que pode ganhar mais entregando mais valor, esta vaga foi criada para o seu próximo nível profissional.
Profissionais medianos se candidatam.
Especialistas de alto nível se posicionam.Sobre a Highmed
A Highmed é uma empresa brasileira especializada no desenvolvimento, comercialização e suporte de equipamentos de alta precisão para medição, teste e diagnóstico. Com uma trajetória de excelência no mercado nacional, nos destacamos pela qualidade e confiabilidade de nossos produtos, que atendem às mais rigorosas normas e padrões
internacionais.Nosso portfólio abrangente inclui soluções inovadoras para ensaios elétricos, termografia, mecânica, segurança no trabalho e teste e medição, atendendo diversos setores como energia, telecomunicações, indústria, construção civil e instituições de pesquisa. Cada produto Highmed é resultado de um compromisso contínuo com a inovação tecnológica e a satisfação dos clientes.Com uma equipe de profissionais altamente capacitados, oferecemos não apenas equipamentos de ponta, mas soluções completas que incluem treinamento, calibração e suporte técnico especializado.Nossa missão é proporcionar a nossos clientes a segurança e precisão necessárias em suas medições, contribuindo para a excelência de seus processos e resultados.

title: Senior data engineer - remote - talent pool
description:
We’re building a talent pool forData Engineers. This pipeline role is for engineers with strong foundation indata modelling (schema design) and SQL experience. You’ll be working across amodern data stack- Airflow, Snowflake, Superset/Looker/HEX, Python, to help power analytics, decision-making, and product insights.
Key Responsibilities:
Taking raw production data and transforming it for analytics use.
Creating data marts organized by business use vs. data origin.
Building AI-ready semantic layer for LLM querying.You’ll be ideal if you have:
Expertise inSQLanddata modelling.
Proficiency withAirflow, Snowflake, and data visualization toolslike Looker, Superset, or HEX.
StrongPythonskills for data workflows and transformations.
Bonus: experience withLLM prompt engineering, RAG, or related AI tools.Ideal traits:
Problem solver with a strong sense of ownership
Communicates clearly—both written and verbal
Business-minded: focused on outcomes, value, and impact
Thrives in fast-paced environments and ambiguity
Background in consumer tech or Saa S is a plusWhy Join Kake?
Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.

title: Supply chain analyst - remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.Overview of the role:We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.Key responsibilities:- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.
- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.
- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.
- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.
- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.
- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.Requirements:- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.
- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.
- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.
- Experience in managing inventory.
- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.
- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.
- Advanced level of English.Benefits:
• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.
• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.
• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.
• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.
• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.
• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.
• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.
• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

title: Ugc content creator (freelance)
description:
About the CompanyWe are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.Role Overview
Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for Tik Tok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.
Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.
Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.
Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.
Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics.
Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.Candidate Profile
Strong interest in Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.
Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).
Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.
Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.
Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds.
Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.
English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.Compensation

title: Csod
description:
About NIIT
At NIIT, we're transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That's why the world's best run learning functions across the globe trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.
NIIT operates in over 40 countries, including the UK, Ireland, France and Germany. Due to rapid expansion in Europe, the company now seeks a new dynamic Business Development Director to significantly increase sales to Fortune 500 companies across Europe.
Link to NIIT Linked In page -
Title: CSOD Implementation consultant
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone On Demand (CSOD)
Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments
Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner Responsibilities:
Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
Actively and effectively partner with L& D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
Identify and communicate system and process issues to L& D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Secretaria clinica odontológica
description:
Descrição da Empresa: Clinica Odontológica de médio porte localizado na Área Octogonal, Brasília-DF.
Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de uma Secretaria Clínica Odontológica para atuar em nossa equipe em Brasília, Distrito Federal. Este cargo requer o gerenciamento de tarefas administrativas relacionadas ao funcionamento diário da clínica, como o agendamento de consultas, organização de documentos e atendimento a pacientes. Outras responsabilidades incluem suporte direto à equipe odontológica, garantindo um ambiente organizado e eficiente. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.
Qualificações
Habilidades Administrativas: Experiência em tarefas administrativas e organizacionais, como gestão de documentos e controle de agenda.
Comunicação: Boa habilidade verbal e escrita, para interagir de forma clara e cortês com pacientes e a equipe da clínica.
Atendimento ao Cliente: Experiência com atendimento ao público, garantindo uma experiência excepcional e demonstrando empatia e profissionalismo.
Suporte Administrativo: Conhecimento em assistência administrativa e secretarial para dar suporte ao time odontológico nas rotinas da clínica.
Requisitos adicionais, como cursos voltados à área odontológica, serão considerados diferenciais.

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

title: Senior business analyst – supply chain
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

description:

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home!
